prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / illustration-story.
Edit the supplied diary pencil illustration. Preserve the exact warm paper, graphite shading, crosshatching, unfinished vignette edges, landscape 3:2 framing, two distinct ordinary adult male characters, plain utilitarian station clothing and industrial transit-corridor setting. Keep the background passengers and quiet observational mood. This is a pencil sketch in Vasyl Vyhovsky's diary, not a polished digital painting.

Make these requested corrections:
1. WEAPONS: remove ALL four existing Caucasian kindjal daggers and their mounts. Each man must now carry EXACTLY ONE SCYTHIAN AKINAKES, in a sheath on HIS OWN ANATOMICAL RIGHT OUTER THIGH, with a plain functional suspension and thigh strap. Exactly TWO weapons in the whole illustration, one per man, no weapon on either man's left hip. For the near-front-facing left figure his right thigh is on the VIEWER'S LEFT side of his body. Pose the farther man with his anatomical right hip visible too; do not mirror his weapon to the wrong side. Make both placements unmistakable.
Akinakes design: compact straight double-edged Scythian short sword, about 40–45 cm total, not curved and not a long saber. Distinctive short broad bilobed / kidney-shaped guard, plain short grip, transverse bar-shaped pommel. Its straight tapering sheath has a practical suspension tab and lies along the right outer thigh. Visible hilt must read as ancient Scythian rather than a modern knife or Caucasian kindjal. Subdued unornamented metal; no fantasy barbs, elaborate gold filigree or glowing blade.
2. HAIR AND MOUSTACHES: both men are Cossacks and must have clearly visible moustaches and Cossack haircuts. The nearer man: shaved sides and most of scalp, ONE long oseledets lock from the crown falling along the temple, long drooping moustache. The farther man: shaved sides with a thick top forelock falling FORWARD over the forehead, shorter broad moustache with slightly upturned ends. No full beard. Keep their faces recognizably distinct and natural.
3. RESPIRATORS: lower the two existing compact respirators to hang at the neck, out of the way of mouths and moustaches. Retain them as station equipment but leave BOTH faces and facial hair clearly visible.
4. DIFFERENT POSES: the nearer man stands naturally with weight on one leg, left hand in a pocket, right arm relaxed beside him without hiding his right-side akinakes; head turned slightly toward the viewer. The farther man stands at a relaxed three-quarter angle with his anatomical right hip exposed to view, arms loosely folded across chest, one knee slightly bent, looking toward his companion. Distinct silhouettes, gestures and head angles. Avoid the identical symmetrical hands-in-pockets poses of the original.

Preserve believable anatomy and realistic ordinary human physiques. No extra people in foreground, no additional weapons, no flags, no blue-and-yellow bands, no modern Ukrainian coat of arms, no three-arrow-fork insignia. No decorative towels, embroidery, sashes, tassels or hanging ornamental cloth. No text, lettering, watermark or signature. Graphite monochrome on the same lightly warm paper; do not change the illustration's style.
